name: ExactInGate
mechanic: Only allows "spend exactly this much" trades; "get exactly this much" is blocked.
plain: There are two ways to place a swap: say exactly how much you'll spend, or say exactly how much you want to receive. This hook only allows the first - 'spend exactly this much'. Orders that demand an exact amount out are turned away.
rules: Only exact-input swaps ('spend exactly this much') are allowed.
Exact-output swaps ('receive exactly this much') are rejected.
